newsitem.title: UK: LME aluminium just above $1,600 after stock draw.
newsitem.headline: LME aluminium just above $1,600 after stock draw.

text.p: COPPER - Ticks higher, above $2,350, after LME stock drop of 1,025 tonnes. Cash/threes backwardation flares further to $108/$113. Resistance at $2,380.
ALUMINIUM - Firmer, just above $1,600, following sizable 5,225 tonne stock decline. Next level at $1,625.
NICKEL - Slightly firmer. OTHERS - Quiet, steady.
